title: [Audit] Security configuration changes
description: Every security configuration change, newest first: API keys created, changed or invalidated, user profile writes, role and privilege edits, with the raw change record. Kibana’s routine API-key clean-up is left out. Elasticsearch records no client IP here.
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL AND NOT (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND api_key.name IS NULL) | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, event.action, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change | SORT @timestamp DESC | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor) | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, event.action AS Action, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change AS Change
